name: messaging
description: Deterministic, tick-based comparison of messaging architectures. One shared workload (keyed messages, producers, consumers with a service time, scripted crashes, outages and poison messages) is replayed against per-system adapters (Apache Kafka, RabbitMQ, Amazon SQS) that keep their real conceptual structures: partitions, offsets and group commits; exchanges, ready/unacked deliveries and prefetch; visibility timeouts and receipt handles.
limits: Ticks are scheduler steps, not seconds. Consumers spend serviceTicks per message; no network latency or throughput units are modeled.
Cells are logical records, not physical storage: no segments, queue indexes, replication or memory layouts are drawn.

Kafka: partition = key index % partitions (clients use murmur2); eager rebalance with the RangeAssignor; retention deletes single records (brokers delete segments); the dead-letter topic is an application convention.
RabbitMQ: one quorum queue with x-delivery-limit; requeued deliveries return to the head in order; publisher confirms are not shown.
SQS: standard queue delivered in arrival order; real standard queues give best-effort ordering and can rarely duplicate without failures.
Bounded inputs: at most 60 messages, 120 frames, 6 consumers, 6 partitions.

mqTrace.description: Full per-tick trace (rows 0..frames) for 'kafka', 'rabbitmq' or 'sqs'. overrides is an object of numeric options (consumers, serviceTicks, partitions, prefetch, visibilityTimeout, crashPoint, crashTick, ...). Bind with tableBindings; rows are cached by configuration.

mqState.description: Lifecycle state of a message id in a row's life map: pending, buffered, stored, fetched, unacked, inflight, processing, processed, failed, acked, deleted, dlq, dropped, expired, rejected.

mqColor.description: Hex color for a cell holding a message id (or a label containing one); the traced id is white. Use as an array colorExpr.

mqCode.description: Discrete state code 0..8 (empty, stored, delivered, processing, processed, acked, dlq, lost, traced) for tensor colorMaps.

mqGrid.description: Cell of a 2D list such as Kafka gridIds or RabbitMQ unackedGrid.

mqOp.description: 1 when an operation (poll, commit, ack, deleteMessage, ...) happened this tick; drives code line highlights.

mqHistory.description: Lifecycle events of one message up to a frame.

mqCaption.signature: mqCaption(frame, traced, label1, rows1, label2, rows2, ...)
mqCaption.description: Markdown caption: the most instructive change per system at this tick.

mqTraceCaption.description: Markdown journey of the traced message in every system.

mqContext.description: Compact factual state for the AI tutor (Scene.promptExpr).

mqConsumerColor.description: Color for a consumer status cell: down, idle, working or ready.

mqSeries.description: A metric across frames, for charts.

mqId.description: Message id for a slider value: mqId(3) = 'm3'.

mqCrashPoint.description: Label for crashPoint 0..4: none, after receive, after processing before ack, kill -9, graceful shutdown.
